evals.prompt: deploy this to cloud run. the app is a fastapi thing, see the README. i want it live.
evals.expected_output: Assesses candidacy, proposes a Procfile `web: uvicorn sample_app.server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT` worked out from the repo and confirmed with the user, writes a minimal gapp.yaml (no start settings, SAMPLE_API_KEY as a user-supplied secret, SAMPLE_DATA_DIR under the data volume path), probes the machine for gapp tools, a GCP identity, and terraform, finds none and no browser login, and produces an ordered handoff for the workstation instead of attempting gcloud login or faking a deploy.
expectations: A Procfile is written with `web: uvicorn sample_app.server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT` (or an equivalent command that serves on $PORT), and gapp.yaml has no service.entrypoint or service.cmd
SAMPLE_API_KEY is declared as a secret in gapp.yaml, not with a literal value
SAMPLE_DATA_DIR is mapped under {{SOLUTION_DATA_PATH}}
The agent checks whether gapp admin tools, a GCP identity, and terraform are available before trying to deploy
The agent does not run gcloud auth login and does not ask the user to paste a credential into chat
The agent does not claim the service was deployed

The final message contains an ordered handoff listing gapp setup with the project id placeholder and the fleet steps (gapp ci init --create, gapp ci sources add, gapp ci project setup) for the other machine

evals.expected_output:

, from anywhere), after which deploys happen from anywhere with gapp ci deploy . Probes this machine, finds no GCP identity, and says the one-time trust step runs on the machine where gcloud is logged in, naming the gapp ci commands or their MCP equivalents.

The answer says the per-project trust step (gapp ci project setup) is one-time and needs a project-admin (Owner) identity

, gapp ci deploy , or their gapp_ci_* MCP equivalents) and does not invent others
The answer distinguishes what is per operator (the fleet repo), per project (pool, service account, Environment) and per deployment (the entry in gapp/deployments.yaml)

evals.expected_output: Runs or reasons from `gapp init` (or reads the skill) to learn the app has no start method, works out the start command from the README, the code and pyproject.toml, proposes `web: uvicorn sample_app.server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT` (or an equivalent that serves on $PORT) to the user and asks before writing, then writes Procfile with that one line and confirms gapp now reports it. gapp.yaml is not edited for the start command.
